source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: However, on the actual board I want [FREELANCER_NAME_002] for the interboard connections because they are considerably more compact.

value_updates.connector_selection: [FREELANCER_NAME_002] connectors for the actual interboard connections

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
For J\_PWR\_POWER, use JST-PH 2.0mm 4-pin:
Pin 1 — 3V3
Pin 2 — GND
Pin 3 — 5V
Pin 4 — GND (5V return)

For J\_PWR\_SIGNAL, use JST-[FREELANCER_NAME_002] 1.25mm 7-pin:
Pin 1 — SDA0
Pin 2 — SCL0
Pin 3 — IRQ
Pin 4 — PWRON
Pin 5 — D+
Pin 6 — D-
Pin 7 — 5V\_EN

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
The sensor board receives two input connections from the main board: one 4-pin JST-PH 2.0mm connector for power (5V, GND, 3V3, GND), plus one 6-pin JST-[FREELANCER_NAME_002] 1.25mm connector carrying the signals (SDA0, SCL0, SDA1, SCL1, UART TX, UART RX).
It also provides these output connectors for the individual sensor modules:

- SCD41 — 4-pin JST-[FREELANCER_NAME_002] (3V3/GND/SDA0/SCL0)
- BME280 — 4-pin JST-[FREELANCER_NAME_002]
- ENS160 — 4-pin JST-[FREELANCER_NAME_002]
- SPS30 — 5-pin JST-ZH 1.5mm (5V, SDA0, SCL0, SEL→GND, GND); this uses a different connector type to match the SPS30 cable
- ZE08-CH2O — 7-pin JST-[FREELANCER_NAME_002], matching the supplied cable
- I2C display — 4-pin JST-[FREELANCER_NAME_002] (3V3/GND/SDA1/SCL1)
- One spare I2C0 port — 4-pin JST-[FREELANCER_NAME_002]
- One spare I2C1 port — 4-pin JST-[FREELANCER_NAME_002]

That makes 10 connectors in total. The complete pinouts are provided in the sensor board doc.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: From the main board, only J\_SENSOR\_PWR (4-pin JST-PH 2.0mm) and J\_SENSOR\_SIG (6-pin JST-[FREELANCER_NAME_002] 1.25mm) are connected.

routing_warnings.description: The supplied evidence index identifies this pin-order flexibility as applying to the power connector; the source does not explicitly identify the signal connector.
The message uses the existing PWRON signal from J_PWR_SIG to add a separate panel-button connector rather than changing the interboard signal interface.
The message changes physical placement and alignment of the interboard connectors, not their signal content or pinout.
